title: Multiclass Boundary Refinement with Neural Cellular Automata for Remote Sensing Land Cover Segmentation
mechanism: Extends rNCA to multiclass: an NCA updates class probabilities of a frozen segmenter in log space so they stay on the simplex, with free hidden channels, correcting boundary position error cell by cell.
adaptation: Multiclass refiner over our 24-class softmax so crack, inactive, gridline and background pixels are traded jointly; train on out-of-fold maps; most useful for inactive borders and crack/inactive overlap.
min_experiment: Arm: house ensemble + multiclass NCA. Baseline: house ensemble. Metrics: inactive IoU, crack IoU, mIoU_rob, boundary IoU on 5-fold CV. Kill: inactive IoU < +0.01 and mIoU_rob < +0.005.
evidence: R: mean boundary IoU 46.63 -> 48.99 over the frozen base; +8.5 BIoU on the most irregular class (woodland).
